analysis:
This batch has only changelog and architecture-doc changes. It contains no source, so no code regression can be shown from it.

Examined claims:
(1) cluster-pair-coordinator-ends-not-failing.md:3-5. Registration timeouts no longer count toward the three-quick-ends local-API fallback. A pair set aside this way is re-offered after 1h. This is an availability change (A-018).
(2) cluster-qwen-pair-public-without-assistant.md:3-6. The Qwen MTP assistant is excluded from coordinator-paired setups. The leader runs full ClusterConfiguration.validate before stopping parts (inference.md head 5372). This tightens behavior.
(3) cluster-release-runtime-facts.md:3-7 and inference.md head 5250-5284. Each release computes cluster_runtime digests and pair-serving grants from its own signed app. When the per-environment repo variables (cluster-release-runtime-facts.md:6) are true, the coordinator auto-approves the build's two-Mac clusters. GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8-27B are declared public in PP/TP on any Apple silicon pair. This rests on an owner decision: no PP run on M5 Ultras and no GLM TP cross-cable record (cluster-release-runtime-facts.md:5).
(4) The catalog-ID omission for a shared artifact (767e03cc:4). It still fails when no candidate is described.
(5) The part heartbeat is moved to a separate part-health.json (inference.md head 3528-3535). The supervisor PID guard is unchanged.
(6) min_p now applies on single Macs. This is a sampling-only change.

Threat-model relevance:
- T-007 and T-056: correctness and attestation overclaim, consumer outputs on A-001.
- T-054 and A-017: qualification consumed by the coordinator.
- TB-011: platform-owned authorization.

The canonical model has no trust boundary dedicated to cluster pairs. Coordinator-paired members predate this PR (base inference.md 229-242), so the missing boundary is not new here.

Open questions for integration and source review:
- Verify ClusterPublicModels, ClusterPairServingGrants.grant and ClusterRuntimeApprovalFacts+Release in source.
- Check the release-workflow gating and whether runtime-facts failure only warns when the variable is unset.
- Check that partEnvironment cannot let a part spoof the service's liveness.
- Check that the platform's acceptance of cluster_runtime is bounded.
- The threat model may need a cluster-pair/public-declaration entry: public serving now relies on owner declarations rather than parity records.

None of this is a regression evidenced in this batch.
